adapter_action.why_CUDA_ARCH_survives: VERIFIED IN THE SOURCE, NOT ASSUMED. CMakeLists.txt:47 reads `if (NOT DEFINED CUDA_ARCH)`, so defining it on the command line skips the whole autodetection block, lines 48-56, including the `message(FATAL_ERROR "Nvidia GPU not found. Abort.")` at line 54 and the `CUDA_SELECT_NVCC_ARCH_FLAGS` call at line 48 that the removed-in-CMake-4 FindCUDA module provides. The runner re-greps these exact lines in the FETCHED bytes before configuring, and stops if the guard is absent.
adapter_action.why_also_CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES: line 12 runs `project(... LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)` BEFORE line 47, so CMake enables the CUDA language and picks its own default architecture first. Line 60 then appends `-gencode=${CUDA_ARCH}` to CMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS and lines 78-83 add the same flags again per target. Setting CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES explicitly makes CMake's own choice agree with the project's hand-rolled gencode instead of silently adding a third, which matters because CUDA_SEPARABLE_COMPILATION is ON for three targets and device linking must see a consistent architecture set.
adapter_action.not_done: no source patch, no sed, no vendored replacement file, no flag shuffling on failure

predicted_first_failure.what: compilation failure from legacy CUDA Dynamic Parallelism in device code
predicted_first_failure.evidence_from_source: src/VX3/VX3_VoxelyzeKernel.cu contains EIGHT device-side kernel launches and EIGHT device-side cudaDeviceSynchronize() calls inside __device__ member functions of VX3_VoxelyzeKernel: launches at lines 230, 267, 301, 310, 426, 434, 443, 454 and 471, each followed by VcudaDeviceSynchronize() (the macro at src/Utils/VX3.cuh:70 expands to cudaDeviceSynchronize()) at lines 232, 269, 303, 312, 428, 437, 446 and 473. The enclosing functions are __device__ void updateTemperature() at line 219, __device__ bool doTimeStep() at 237, __device__ void updateAttach() at 401 and __device__ void updateDetach() at 461.
predicted_first_failure.why_that_should_fail: device-side cudaDeviceSynchronize() was deprecated in CUDA 11.6 and removed in CUDA 12.0, where CDP2 replaced the legacy interface and dropped device-side synchronisation entirely.
predicted_first_failure.if_it_fails_this_way: record it and STOP. Do not patch the synchronisation out: removing a device-side sync is a SEMANTIC change to the integration order, not an adapter action, and a build repaired that way would answer a different question than the one asked.
predicted_first_failure.if_it_does_NOT_fail_this_way: that is the more interesting outcome and the run should continue to the history checks. Report what actually happened.
other_plausible_stops_ranked: Boost absent in the image: find_package(Boost REQUIRED ...) at CMakeLists.txt:37 fails at CONFIGURE time, before nvcc is ever invoked, so the CUDA question would go unanswered. The runner installs the four components it needs as an AUTHORISED, RECORDED step and writes dpkg versions plus static-library sha256 into the receipt. --no-dep-install turns that off and reports DEP_MISSING_BOOST instead.

CMake 4.x removed the FindCUDA module, so find_package(CUDA) at line 45 finds nothing. Because CUDA_ARCH is defined, CUDA_SELECT_NVCC_ARCH_FLAGS is never called, so this is expected to be survivable. Not verified.

cases.actuation_law_read_from_source: src/VX3/VX3_VoxelyzeKernel.cu:636-646 computes T(t) = TempAmplitude * sin(2*pi*(t/TempPeriod + phaseOffset)), and because EnableExpansion is 0 it CLIPS T at zero, so voxels only contract. TempBase is NOT used on the CUDA path, only in the legacy src/old CPU path. With CTE 0.01 and amplitude 10 the zero-stress extent should run 10.0 mm down to 9.0 mm.

acceptance.why_contiguity_not_just_non_emptiness: the history is written by printf from INSIDE a __global__ kernel, so it passes through the CUDA device printf FIFO ring buffer. On overflow, lines are dropped SILENTLY. A non-emptiness check passes on truncated output; a stride check does not.

discriminator.quantity: per-frame mean voxel x-extent, computed as field[10] - field[7], the PPP minus NNN corner offsets, which carry both the thermal factor and the elastic strain (src/VX3/VX3_Voxel.cu:147-158)
discriminator.A3_actuated_contracts: actuated mean extent < passive mean extent, because EnableExpansion 0 clips temperature at zero
discriminator.A1_fail: DISCRIMINATOR_FAIL: the program ran but the actuation path did not take effect. Not a working build.
discriminator.A2_fail: INCONCLUSIVE: the control is not quiet, so the contrast does not separate actuation from settling.
discriminator.A3_fail: INCONCLUSIVE: extent changed but did not contract, so the case or the clip does not behave as the source says.
